_comment: Curated + locked, seeded from InferenceCarbon_TokenSec_Daily_Mistral.xlsx frontier set, using -latest aliases. Magistral = reasoning family, Mistral/Ministral = non-reasoning; the reasoning split is via separate model ids, so one variant each. 2026-07-23: the recorder now (a) splits think-tag reasoning out of the visible stream — magistral-small visible-tok/s values BEFORE this date are inflated by streamed thinking and are not comparable; (b) records the resolved model id behind each -latest alias per request (magistral-small-latest resolved to a materially different version than the one carried in the external comparison series, so cross-series comparisons for this variant are not meaningful). Check 'Resolved model' in the engine workbook before comparing across series. Edit by hand.
